lines.zh: 熔岩在鳃边流过，比水更烫更好。
lines.en: The lava slides past my gills, hotter than water and better.

lines.zh: 我沿着岩浆湖的边缘划出一道红线。
lines.en: I draw a red streak along the edge of the lava lake.

lines.zh: 别用网，我只认这一池滚烫的橘红。
lines.en: Skip the net; I only know this pool of scalding orange.

lines.zh: 尾巴一摆，整条熔岩河都亮了起来。
lines.en: One flick of my tail and the whole lava river brightens.

lines.zh: 游过黑曜石边缘，鳞片被烫得发亮。
lines.en: I pass the obsidian rim, scales glowing from the heat.

lines.zh: 水流会杀死我，所以我在火里走。
lines.en: Water would kill me, so I walk inside fire.

lines.zh: 我的条纹是岩浆教我的颜色。
lines.en: My stripes are the color lava taught me.

lines.zh: 深处有气泡，我得赶在它破裂前过去。
lines.en: Bubbles rise deep below; I must pass before they burst.

lines.zh: 石头在脚下熔化，我踩着它游。
lines.en: The stone melts under me and I swim on it.

lines.zh: 这条熔岩沟是我出生的地方。
lines.en: This lava trench is where I was born.

lines.zh: 别挡住我的路线，我只会往热处去。
lines.en: Do not block my route; I only go toward heat.

lines.zh: 每一道鳞纹都在给岩浆让路。
lines.en: Every scale ridge makes way for the magma.

lines.zh: 我听见岩浆在石头里呼吸。
lines.en: I hear the magma breathing inside the stone.

lines.zh: 红色的鱼在红色的河里，不容易找。
lines.en: A red fish in a red river is hard to find.

lines.zh: 有岩浆滴下来，我往旁边一偏。
lines.en: Lava drips from above. I veer aside.

lines.zh: 热流从下面顶上来，我借它往前。
lines.en: A hot current pushes up. I ride it forward.

lines.zh: 我悬在熔岩里，等一只笨虫子掉下来。
lines.en: I hang in the lava, waiting for some clumsy bug to fall.

lines.zh: 静止的时候，我像一块烧红的碎玻璃。
lines.en: At rest I look like a shard of red-hot glass.

lines.zh: 岩浆冒泡的声音让我想睡。
lines.en: The bubbling of magma makes me sleepy.

lines.zh: 我的鳍在热流里一张一合。
lines.en: My fins open and close in the hot current.

lines.zh: 别盯着看，我不是火，只是住在火里。
lines.en: Do not stare; I am not fire, I just live in it.

lines.zh: 这条鱼不缺食物，只缺安静。
lines.en: This fish lacks no food, only quiet.

lines.zh: 我数着气泡，一个一个往上冒。
lines.en: I count the bubbles rising one by one.

lines.zh: 熔岩湖的心跳比我的慢。
lines.en: The lava lake's heartbeat is slower than mine.

lines.zh: 我把自己藏在橘色的光里。
lines.en: I hide myself inside the orange light.

lines.zh: 水边的木头会烧起来，我离远些。
lines.en: Wood near the water catches fire; I keep my distance.

lines.zh: 我贴着沟底，影子被火吞掉了。
lines.en: I press to the trench floor; the fire swallows my shadow.

lines.zh: 一条只有两心的鱼，也敢住在这里。
lines.en: A fish with two hearts still dares to live here.

lines.zh: 冷空气从洞口吹来，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Cold air blows from the cave mouth; I dislike it.

lines.zh: 我等着岩浆把我推向下游。
lines.en: I wait for the magma to push me downstream.

lines.zh: 你在岸边站着，脚底的石头还是热的。
lines.en: You stand on the bank; the stone under you is still warm.

lines.zh: 你不是鱼，你身上没有岩浆味。
lines.en: You are no fish; you carry no smell of magma.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，你就往后退了一步。
lines.en: I look up and you step back once.

lines.zh: 我记得你的靴子，上次也是这双。
lines.en: I remember those boots; they came last time too.

lines.zh: 你的影子落进熔岩，变红了。
lines.en: Your shadow falls into the lava and turns red.

lines.zh: 别伸手，我的鳞片会烫伤你。
lines.en: Do not reach in; my scales will burn you.

lines.zh: 你眼睛里有火，跟我住的一样。
lines.en: There is fire in your eyes, the same I live in.

lines.zh: 你看我，我看你脚下的黑曜石。
lines.en: You watch me; I watch the obsidian under your feet.

lines.zh: 我认得活物的味道，也认得铁。
lines.en: I know the smell of the living, and of iron.

lines.zh: 你离开时，水壶在响。
lines.en: When you leave, your waterskin is rattling.

lines.zh: 你敢碰我？我的鳞片会烫你。
lines.en: You dare touch me? My scales will burn you.

lines.zh: 这一下把我从热流里打出来。
lines.en: That knocked me out of the hot current.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴断了一截，还在抽动。
lines.en: Part of my tail is gone and still twitching.

lines.zh: 疼，但岩浆会替我止住血。
lines.en: It hurts, but magma will stop the bleeding.

lines.zh: 你打的是火里的东西，代价不小。
lines.en: You struck a thing of fire; that costs you.

lines.zh: 我只有两心，一下就快没了。
lines.en: I have only two hearts, and one hit nearly ends me.

lines.zh: 我的血滴进熔岩，滋一声就没了。
lines.en: My blood drips into magma and hisses away.

lines.zh: 别追，我受伤时游得最快。
lines.en: Do not chase; I swim fastest when wounded.

lines.zh: 你的气味已经烙在我鳃里。
lines.en: Your scent is seared into my gills now.

lines.zh: 我钻进石缝，你手伸不进来。
lines.en: I slip into a crack where your hand cannot reach.

lines.zh: 那是什么？闻起来像烧焦的虫子。
lines.en: What is that? It smells like a scorched bug.

lines.zh: 你把东西丢进岩浆，它就没了。
lines.en: You drop something into the lava and it is gone.

lines.zh: 我不吃你手上的，我只吃漂过来的。
lines.en: I do not eat from your hand, only what drifts by.

lines.zh: 诱饵在火里化开，我懒得动。
lines.en: The bait melts in the fire; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 有点香味，但还不够烫。
lines.en: There is some smell, but it is not hot enough.

lines.zh: 你撒的面包屑立刻变成黑炭。
lines.en: Your crumbs turn to black char instantly.

lines.zh: 我绕了一圈，只是看看，不是想吃。
lines.en: I circle once just to look, not to eat.

lines.zh: 拿着食物的人也拿着钓竿，我懂。
lines.en: The one holding food also holds a rod; I understand.

lines.zh: 我靠近一点，只为确认那不是石头。
lines.en: I come closer only to check it is not a stone.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西太凉，不合我口味。
lines.en: What you hold is too cold for my taste.

lines.zh: 撞到我？我身上全是烫的黏液。
lines.en: Bump me? I am covered in scalding slime.

lines.zh: 你的腿碰到熔岩，先叫的是你。
lines.en: Your leg touches lava, and you scream first.

lines.zh: 我撞开一块浮石，继续往前。
lines.en: I knock a floating stone aside and keep going.

lines.zh: 别挤，这条沟只够一条鱼。
lines.en: Do not crowd; this trench fits one fish.

lines.zh: 被我一碰，你的护甲开始冒烟。
lines.en: One touch from me and your armor starts to smoke.

lines.zh: 我用头顶你一下，是让你让路。
lines.en: I butt you once to make you step aside.

lines.zh: 碰撞让我翻了个身，鳞片全红了。
lines.en: The knock rolls me over; every scale flares red.

lines.zh: 你在水里比我慢，在火里更慢。
lines.en: You are slower than me in water, slower still in fire.

lines.zh: 我擦过你的靴子，留下焦痕。
lines.en: I brush your boot and leave a scorch mark.

lines.zh: 挤过来之前，先看看脚下的岩浆。
lines.en: Before you shove in, look at the lava under you.

lines.zh: 另一条红线从下游游上来。
lines.en: Another red line swims up from downstream.

lines.zh: 我们并排，鳞片互相擦出火星。
lines.en: We swim side by side, scales striking sparks.

lines.zh: 繁殖的季节，整条沟都是红的。
lines.en: In mating season the whole trench runs red.

lines.zh: 它比我大一圈，尾巴是橙的。
lines.en: It is a size larger, with an orange tail.

lines.zh: 我们在熔岩里绕圈，像两粒火星。
lines.en: We circle in the lava like two sparks.

lines.zh: 卵要生在黑曜石的缝里，才够暖。
lines.en: The eggs must go in obsidian cracks to stay warm.

lines.zh: 它撞我一下，我知道它同意了。
lines.en: It bumps me once, and I know it agrees.

lines.zh: 两条鱼把水面烧出一片光。
lines.en: Two fish burn a patch of light on the surface.

lines.zh: 幼鱼一出生就会往热处游。
lines.en: The fry swim toward heat the moment they hatch.

lines.zh: 这条沟太小，容不下第三只。
lines.en: This trench is too small for a third.

lines.zh: 我叼着的不是物品，是一块温热的碎石。
lines.en: What I hold is not an item, but a warm pebble.

lines.zh: 你伸手来拿，我把它吞了。
lines.en: You reach for it, so I swallow it.

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西在岩浆里沉底。
lines.en: Whatever falls sinks to the bottom of the magma.

lines.zh: 我不捡东西，我只捡温度。
lines.en: I do not pick up things, only warmth.

lines.zh: 这块黑曜石是我捡的，别动。
lines.en: I picked up this obsidian; leave it.

lines.zh: 沉下去的铁片，我偶尔会顶上来。
lines.en: Sometimes I nudge sunken iron back up.

lines.zh: 我的嘴里放不下你的宝贝。
lines.en: My mouth has no room for your treasure.

lines.zh: 那是你的东西？现在它在我这儿。
lines.en: That was yours? It is here with me now.

lines.zh: 我碰了一下，它就开始熔化。
lines.en: I touch it once and it begins to melt.

lines.zh: 想从鱼嘴里拿东西，得先下火。
lines.en: To take from a fish's mouth, step into the fire first.

lines.zh: 有东西在水边移动，我游过去看。
lines.en: Something moves by the water; I swim over to look.

lines.zh: 一只小虫掉进熔岩，我盯上了它。
lines.en: A bug drops into the lava and I fix on it.

lines.zh: 我锁定了岸上那个影子。
lines.en: I lock onto that shadow on the bank.

lines.zh: 你踩响的石头暴露了位置。
lines.en: The stone you rattled gave away your place.

lines.zh: 我不追快的，我只追靠近火的。
lines.en: I chase no fast things, only those near fire.

lines.zh: 目标在热气里晃动，我看见它了。
lines.en: The target wavers in the heat; I see it.

lines.zh: 那条鱼游进我的沟，就是我的。
lines.en: That fish entered my trench, so it is mine.

lines.zh: 我闻到皮毛烧焦的味道。
lines.en: I smell fur burning.

lines.zh: 我调头，朝热源的方向去。
lines.en: I turn and head toward the heat source.

lines.zh: 你退得越远，我越懒得追。
lines.en: The farther you retreat, the less I bother.

lines.zh: 我绕到你背后，顺着岩流。
lines.en: I circle behind you along the rock flow.

lines.zh: 别跑向水边，那里我更慢。
lines.en: Do not run to the water; I am slower there.

lines.zh: 我在等你脚滑一下。
lines.en: One slip of your boot is all I need.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就顺着热流跟一步。
lines.en: You step back once, and I follow along the warm current.

lines.zh: 熔岩在我们之间流，像条线。
lines.en: Lava flows between us like a drawn line.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛只看得见热的东西。
lines.en: My eyes see only what is warm.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸变短了，我听得见。
lines.en: Your breathing shortens; I hear every gasp.

lines.zh: 你举起武器，我先沉下去。
lines.en: You raise your weapon, so I sink first.

lines.zh: 我在石头下面跟着你走。
lines.en: I follow beneath the stone as you walk.

lines.zh: 这片橙光里，你藏不住。
lines.en: In this orange glow you cannot hide.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的小腿，烫得你跳。
lines.en: I hit your calf and the heat makes you jump.

lines.zh: 一口下去，只咬到护甲的缝。
lines.en: One bite, and I only catch an armor seam.

lines.zh: 我的牙齿小，但带着岩浆。
lines.en: My teeth are small, but they carry magma.

lines.zh: 你被烫了一下，退了两步。
lines.en: The burn makes you retreat two steps.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，尾巴甩在你脸上。
lines.en: I lunge and whip my tail across your face.

lines.zh: 咬完我就走，不追第二口。
lines.en: I bite once and leave, no second bite.

lines.zh: 你靴子上的焦痕是我留的。
lines.en: The scorch on your boot is mine.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，只是提醒你别下水。
lines.en: This was light, just a warning to stay out of the lava.

lines.zh: 我用头撞，比咬更管用。
lines.en: I ram with my head; it works better than biting.

lines.zh: 打完我沉回熔岩，鳞片还热。
lines.en: Done, I sink back into the lava, scales still hot.

lines.zh: 熔岩里一阵翻涌，我游了出来。
lines.en: The lava churns and I swim out.

lines.zh: 这条沟第一次有了红条纹。
lines.en: This trench has red stripes for the first time.

lines.zh: 火光照出我的影子，很长。
lines.en: The firelight throws my shadow long.

lines.zh: 我从岩浆深处上来，带着气泡。
lines.en: I rise from deep magma, trailing bubbles.

lines.zh: 别奇怪，鱼也能生在火里。
lines.en: Do not wonder; a fish can be born in fire.

lines.zh: 这条沟的水位刚好够我翻身。
lines.en: The level here is just enough for me to turn.

lines.zh: 我出生时，石头还是软的。
lines.en: When I was born, the stone was still soft.

lines.zh: 岩浆退了一点，露出我的窝。
lines.en: The magma receded a little and showed my nest.

lines.zh: 第一条进来的鱼，总要看看四周。
lines.en: The first fish in always looks around.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片还带着熔岩的温度。
lines.en: My scales still carry the lava's temperature.

lines.zh: 火对我来说只是洗澡水。
lines.en: Fire is only bathwater to me.

lines.zh: 从高处摔进熔岩，还好是熔岩。
lines.en: Fell from height into lava; lucky it was lava.

lines.zh: 水灌进鳃里，这是我唯一怕的。
lines.en: Water in my gills; the only thing I fear.

lines.zh: 炸开的石头把整条沟都堵了。
lines.en: The blast heaped stone across my whole trench.

lines.zh: 箭从岸上飞来，扎进我的背。
lines.en: An arrow came from the bank and sank into my back.

lines.zh: 那股冷气顺着鳞片爬进来。
lines.en: That cold crept in along my scales.

lines.zh: 熔岩里没有食物，我开始变淡。
lines.en: Nothing to eat in the lava; my color fades.

lines.zh: 雷劈在湖面，整池火都跳起来。
lines.en: Lightning struck the lake and the whole pool jumped.

lines.zh: 下面是空的，连岩浆也掉下去了。
lines.en: Below is nothing; even the lava falls away.
